C0038.title: Trackable Logistics but Vanished Package: 'Phantom Parcel' Scheme Unravels a Billion-Yuan Fraud Ring
C0038.summary: In March 2019, a Mr. Lin in Wuxi purchased a mobile phone online. The courier tracking showed the package had been signed for by a security guard, but he never received it. Investigation revealed the seller had used a fake tracking number generated by an empty-package website.
